newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area late Monday. There were no test on slaughter steers or heifers at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Last established market was 67.00 in a limited test on Friday. Bids today are 65.00-66.00 with asking prices 68.00-70.00. 800 head confirmed for the week to date.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: 8,200 Year Ago: 200
Wk to Date: 800 Week Ago: 11,200 Year Ago: 17,500
